claims.subject: relationship--lazarus--related-to--2e19c64304ab7fa6
claims.statement: Lazarus Group related-to Andariel: MITRE considers Andariel a subset of Lazarus Group; U.S. Treasury also describes Andariel as a Lazarus subgroup controlled by the RGB.
claims.verification_rationale: Verified OSINT relationship: status=supported; limitation=Lazarus is also used as a broad umbrella label in some reporting, so operation-level attribution should retain the Andariel label where supported. counterevidence=The sources warn that DPRK cluster boundaries overlap; subgroup status does not imply identical tooling across all Lazarus activity.

claims.subject: relationship--lazarus--overlaps-with--de3c46e582cd6cc5
claims.statement: Lazarus Group overlaps-with APT38: Government sources connect Bluenoroff/APT38 and Lazarus under the RGB and a common conspiracy, while industry reporting preserves APT38 as a financially focused cluster.
claims.verification_rationale: Verified OSINT relationship: status=partially-supported; limitation=APT38, Bluenoroff, and Lazarus have vendor-dependent scopes; exact equivalence should not be asserted. counterevidence=The DOJ's common-conspiracy framing is organizational/legal and does not prove identical operational clustering.

claims.subject: relationship--lazarus--mitre--f754724d65769ec6
claims.statement: Lazarus Group overlaps-with APT37: North Korean group definitions are known to have significant overlap, and some security researchers report all North Korean state-sponsored cyber activity under the name [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) instead of tracking clusters or subgroups.
claims.verification_rationale: MITRE relationship extraction: status=supported; A narrative cross-reference establishes a relationship but does not by itself prove exact actor identity or identical scope.

claims.subject: relationship--lazarus--mitre--af89d5a7e6439319
claims.statement: Lazarus Group overlaps-with Kimsuky: DPRK threat actor cluster boundaries overlap in open source reporting, with some security researchers consolidating all attributed North Korean state-sponsored cyber activity under [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032), rather than tracking operationally distinct subgroups.
claims.verification_rationale: MITRE relationship extraction: status=supported; A narrative cross-reference establishes a relationship but does not by itself prove exact actor identity or identical scope.

claims.subject: relationship--lazarus--mitre--2122e662003ee1f8
claims.statement: Lazarus Group overlaps-with Sharpshooter: Though overlaps between this adversary and [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) have been noted, definitive links have not been established.(Citation: McAfee Sharpshooter December 2018)
claims.verification_rationale: MITRE relationship extraction: status=supported; A narrative cross-reference establishes a relationship but does not by itself prove exact actor identity or identical scope.

claims.subject: relationship--lazarus--mitre--065309de62bfe181
claims.statement: Lazarus Group overlaps-with Moonstone Sleet: The group previously overlapped significantly with another North Korean-linked entity, [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032), but has differentiated its tradecraft since 2023.
claims.verification_rationale: MITRE relationship extraction: status=supported; A narrative cross-reference establishes a relationship but does not by itself prove exact actor identity or identical scope.

claims.subject: relationship--lazarus--mitre--84f8d531c802a4c0
claims.statement: Lazarus Group related-to AppleJeus: Associated with the broader [Lazarus Group](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0032) umbrella of actors, [AppleJeus](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1049) has been active since at least 2018 and is closely aligned in resources with TEMP.hermit, another DPRK-affiliated group under the same umbrella.(Citation: dtex DPRK 2025 structure ITworkers) The group’s primary mission is to generate and launder revenue to provide financial support to the government.
claims.verification_rationale: MITRE relationship extraction: status=partially-supported; A narrative cross-reference establishes a relationship but does not by itself prove exact actor identity or identical scope.
